answer.title: Automate Purchase Order Approval and Creation
answer.trigger: An approved purchase order email is received from Sarah.
steps: Monitor incoming emails for purchase order approval confirmations from Sarah.
Extract the purchase order reference and details from the approved email.
Draft a new purchase order in the accounts system based on the extracted details.
Flag the draft purchase order for James to review and finalize.
answer.ai_help: Extracting the purchase order reference, item details, and approval status from the email thread.
answer.human_approval: James must review the drafted purchase order in the accounts system before final submission.
answer.risk_reason: Errors in purchase order amounts or items could lead to incorrect supplier orders and financial discrepancies.
